research_question: What evidence supports historical-modern continuity between Steffel participial -ameke/-ame and modern participial/derivational -ame/-ami?

steffel.ke_variation: Steffel reports frequent omission of final ke in pronunciation
steffel.rugameke_explicit_composition: Steffel explicitly combines passive ruc with active ameke in at least one analysis

merrill_2020.final_element: optional reduplicative -kV/-ke in relevant suffix chains
merrill_2020.important_distinction: Merrill provides the modern morpheme segmentation; this segmentation is not retroactively attributed to Steffel.

modern_src02.explicit_counterexample_to_ami_equals_pp: Hua ‘madurarse’ distinguishes ad. huáami from pp. huacami
modern_src02.interpretation: Final -ami is a broad surface class, not a grammatical category equivalent to Pp; participial evidence must be tracked separately from string-final distribution.

comparative_uto_aztecan.status: independent comparative support; Hill notes some sets remain provisional

priority_candidates.strength: historical family koči- grouped and phonetically normalized by Merrill; modern root kotʃi explicit in Caballero; SRC-02 Cochí->pp cochíami; Hill comparative ko-02; participial function explicit on both chronological sides
priority_candidates.open_problem: historical -mé in kočimé remains unexplained; full-word cognacy not adjudicated

priority_candidates.strength: historical guarding/caretaker relation including pouguá nesséameke ‘pastor de ovejas’; modern Nisé ‘cuidar, pastorear’ -> Niséami ‘Pastor’
priority_candidates.open_problem: formal correspondence nesse~nise and dialect chronology require adjudication

priority_candidates.strength: historical local ruler/Dorfrichter, modern traditional governor, independent Choguita governor form; Merrill documents medial l~r variation elsewhere in Steffel
priority_candidates.open_problem: specific application of l~r correspondence and full cognacy remain unadjudicated

priority_candidates.strength: historical-modern formal/semantic overlap; modern Chipérami ‘Plano’ is directly classified Pp
priority_candidates.open_problem: full root correspondence and historical morphology remain to be demonstrated
modern Chócami is Adj, not source-explicit Pp; do not use as direct participial evidence

working_model: Historical evidence now supports a published participial morpheme -(a)me inside relevant -ameke chains plus optional -kV/-ke, while modern evidence independently documents participial -ame and numerous -ami derivatives including source-explicit participles. The most defensible hypothesis is continuity of a participial/derivational domain, tested lexeme by lexeme and variety by variety, not a blanket rule -ameke > -ami.
methodological_rules: Keep Steffel's metalinguistic statements separate from Merrill's modern segmentation.
Do not equate final -ami with Pp.
Do not treat exact-string base matches as derivations without semantic/source audit.
Do not infer cognacy from graphic similarity alone.
Promote or demote candidates when source-explicit evidence changes, preserving version history.
